info.title: HireStream API
info.description:
# HireStream Enterprise Hiring Platform API

This API powers the HireStream ATS (Applicant Tracking System), providing endpoints for:
- **Authentication**: JWT-based login and Google SSO
- **Hiring Workflow**: Requisitions, applications, and interview scheduling
- **Candidate Portal**: Profile management and job discovery
- **Resource Management**: Administrative controls and approval workflows
- **AI Services**: Resume scoring and JD generation
